<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">KITESURFING SCHOOL</h1>
</div>
</div></div><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-6 span-6"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-6dd017332dd999aab00e"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">ideal conditions for learning</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The shallow and sheer water of Sakalava Bay gives you the best condition to learn kitesurfing with the wind blowing from March to mid-December. Our kitesurf club will provide you with the perfect courses.</p><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">&nbsp;</h2><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">kitesurf school</h2><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Brand new gear : <strong>Reedin 2024 and Ozone 2025!</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Located within our hotel</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our school is ideally located right in front of the spot! No need to walk along the beach to start riding.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Gear rental included in the lesson price!</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">French and English-speaking instructors and manager</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Windsurf</strong> and <strong>Kitesurf</strong> rental</p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>MPORTANT: Please note that we cannot accept accommodation reservations for people taking lessons or renting their equipment from another establishment.</strong></p>
</div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block" data-aspect-ratio="20.734341252699785" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/196a0616-0851-49d9-8880-a77dcdbd4fc0_1299/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/196a0616-0851-49d9-8880-a77dcdbd4fc0_1299/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_4_1494930687907_183211" id="block-yui_3_17_2_4_1494930687907_183211"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_4_1494930687907_183274"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">EQUIPMENT AND GEARS RENTAL</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">If you take courses, the gear rental is already included in the lesson fee.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">FULL EQUIPMENT</p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>One hour -- 30€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Half day   -- &nbsp;50€&nbsp;(Beyond 1h - 3 hours max)</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Full day &nbsp; -- &nbsp;75€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>7 days &nbsp;    -- &nbsp;400€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>14 days&nbsp;   -- &nbsp;680€</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">TWIN TIP</p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Half day   -- &nbsp;20€&nbsp;(3 hours max)</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Full day &nbsp; -- &nbsp;25€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>7 days      -- &nbsp;150€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong> 14 days&nbsp;  -- &nbsp;250€</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">SURF BOARD</p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Half day   -- &nbsp;25€&nbsp;(3 hours max)</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Full day &nbsp; -- &nbsp;30€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>7 days  &nbsp;  -- &nbsp;190€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong> 14 days&nbsp; -- &nbsp;350€</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">FOIL</p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong> Per hour -- &nbsp;25€</strong></p>
</div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block" data-aspect-ratio="31.749460043196546" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/196a0616-0851-49d9-8880-a77dcdbd4fc0_1299/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/196a0616-0851-49d9-8880-a77dcdbd4fc0_1299/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1651150249763_661416" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1651150249763_661416"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1651150249763_586035"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">OPTIONAL DAMAGED GEAR INSURANCE</h2><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">The insurance is proposed for the rental only.</p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Full day &nbsp; -- &nbsp;20€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>7 days &nbsp;   -- &nbsp;70€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>14 days &nbsp; -- &nbsp;100€<br><br></strong>This insurance is valid only one time.</p>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">WHY TAKE KITESURFING COURSES?</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Why not? :) Your first <strong>kitesurf </strong>courses (from 10 to 75) allow you to get a first taste of kite maneuvers et learn all security techniques and processes, all in a very chill atmosphere ! No physical condition is necessary:&nbsp;kitesurfing doesn't require any strength. Everything is about coordination and touch.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">You can be autonomous between an average of 10 to 20 hours!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><em>All kite gear and security equipments are included in the price.</em></strong></p><p class="" data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"></p><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">PRIVATE LESSONS</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">If you take courses, the gear rental is already included in the lesson fee.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">BEGINNER OR ADVANCED<br>(One kite and one instructor per student)</p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>01 h &nbsp;-- &nbsp;55€&nbsp;</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>06 h -- 320€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>10 h &nbsp;-- &nbsp;500€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Beyond 10h &nbsp;-- &nbsp;48€/h</strong></p><p class="" data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"></p><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">ADVANCED LESSONS</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">If you take courses, the gear rental is already included in the lesson fee. </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Would you like to improve your <strong>freestyle</strong>, <strong>wave riding</strong>, <strong>kitefoiling</strong> skills? An instructor will personally teach you the tricks you have ever dreamt of, to put some fun in your sessions and enhance your kitesurfing style!</p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><br><strong>01 h &nbsp;-- &nbsp;55€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>06 h -- 320€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>10 h &nbsp;-- &nbsp;500€</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Beyond 10h &nbsp;-- &nbsp;48€/h</strong></p><p class="" data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"></p><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">ASSISTANCE</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Assistance is reserved for kiters who already know how to ride both ways but who still have difficulties to go upwind. An instructor will be here to get your kite upwind and will assist you in case you need it.</p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Half day  -- &nbsp;15€ (up to 3h)</strong></p><p style="margin-left:40px;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Full day  -- &nbsp; 30€ (beyond 3h)</strong></p>
</div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block" data-aspect-ratio="8.947368421052632" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/196a0616-0851-49d9-8880-a77dcdbd4fc0_1299/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/196a0616-0851-49d9-8880-a77dcdbd4fc0_1299/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1669650649957_356149" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1669650649957_356149"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1669650649957_359975"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">BROKEN GEARS FEE (FOR RENTAL ONLY)</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Canopy tearing up to 30cm.          -- 40€<br><br>Canopy tearing up to 60cm.          -- 70€<br><br>Canopy tearing beyond 60cm.      -- 1,5€/cm<br><br>Out of order gear                             -- 70% retail price<br><br>Board loss                                         -- 70% retail price<br><br>Broken board                                     -- 70% retail price</strong></p>

The management of KiteParadise Madagascar cannot be held responsible for any damage, loss, or accident involving kite equipment or personal belongings caused during these support activities.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We kindly remind guests that:</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">All kite equipment is used and handled at your own risk.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Any rescue or beach assistance is carried out as a courtesy only.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We strongly recommend having personal travel insurance that covers sports equipment and accidents.</p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">By staying with us and making use of our facilities, you acknowledge and accept this policy.</p>
